act_one.synopsis: John wakes up as Zhang Mazi. He saves Liuzi from suicide/execution. He enters Goose Town, confronts the local power structure, and realizes Arthur might be here.

chapters.summary: The Hongmen Banquet. John rejects Huang's money.

act_two.synopsis: Open war with Huang. John uses Western tactics to dismantle Huang's power base while searching for Arthur.

chapters.title: The Great Train Robbery
chapters.synopsis: John decides to cut off Huang's opium revenue. He organizes a train robbery using horses to stop the 'horse-drawn train'.

chapters.title: The Shadow of Civilization
chapters.synopsis: Fallout from the robbery. Milton takes control of Huang's operation. Tang panics. John prepares for the storm.

chapters.title: The Iron Beast
chapters.synopsis: The ambush at the Madam's Tomb. Milton deploys snipers and a Maxim gun. John and Liuzi are pinned down. John uses Dead Eye to disable the gunner, but realizes the technological gap is too wide.

scene_sequence.core_action: The ceremony begins. Tang reads the eulogy nervously. John scans the perimeter.
John drags Liuzi behind a tombstone. Snipers pin them down.
The tombstone is disintegrating under fire. John activates Dead Eye.
scene_sequence.scene_outcome: The gunner is hit. The gun jams.

scene_sequence.core_action: They escape into the dense forest where the gun can't follow.
scene_sequence.scene_outcome: They survive, but the war has changed.

chapters.title: Whispers in the Dark
chapters.synopsis: John realizes he needs intel to find Arthur and defeat Milton. He plans to infiltrate the town at night.

chapters.title: The Alliance
chapters.synopsis: John seeks allies among the oppressed miners/coolies.
